Callout.Name: Drunk Driver Reported
Callout.Message: Caller following a vehicle being driven erratically.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle swerving, speed varying between 20 and 60.

Script.Line: I am two cars behind it and it cannot hold a lane.
It was twenty, then sixty, then twenty again.
It has just clipped the kerb. It is on the kerb now.

Lines.Approach: The caller is behind it and says it cannot hold a lane. They will stay on the line.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
